profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer In Test
profile.summary: A passionate and adaptive problem solver with a fierce love of learning and creating, demonstrating a history of building automation efforts from scratch in the aerospace and intelligence industries. Educated in Computer Information Systems / Cybersecurity from Georgia State University and a certification from Emory University for Machine Learning and Big Data.

positions.title: Software Engineer In Test II
positions.description:
- Lead tester for UI team
- Managed audit of existing test suite- from 50% failures to <1%. 
- Led weekly syncs for automation
- Created automation with Cypress JS framework
- Implemented process changes between developers, UX, product, and QA
- Initiated CICD jobs for scheduled test runs
- Set up dashboard and visible alerts for Cypress tests

positions.title: Lead Software Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
-Providing manual / automated test coverage to our predictive analysis platform in an Agile environment
-Leading UI automation effort with Cypress E2E tests for large-scale predictive analysis platform
-Supported teams with automated & manual testing for Spark / Airflow integration
-Testing internal data ingest tool using Kubernetes and Postman API
-Monitoring Postman API testing to monitor data ingest 
- Primary UI tester (functional, positive, negative, exploratory) supporting teams with automation and manual testing
-Create test cases for automated / manual tests based on Data Scientist's use cases for predictive analysis platform
-Translate test cases to automated smoke tests in Cypress for the QA environment
-Find, verify, track, and document bugs in the platform in JIRA for Data Engineering, Platform, and Interfaces teams
-Scale automated tests to run in Develop and UAT environments
-Determine product requirements
-Contribute consistently to UX design efforts
-Solve problems involving cross-pod functionality

positions.title: Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
Create automated regression test scripts using Cypress
Integrate Cypress scripts with builds and set up crons for running the tests
Manually test the current and legacy software on customer-facing and administrative sides
Use Postman to test API calls
Train other engineers on the process of using Cypress

positions.title: Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
Built manual and automated tests to QA the flagship product (Failsafe)
Prototyped new security technology hosted on AWS
Wrote micro test frameworks in Ruby to cover small internal projects
Developed and administered performance analysis tests on live customer deployments

positions.title: Digital Media Intern
positions.description:
Researched new media sharing platforms and analyzed them based on various factors of effectiveness
Brainstormed projects to enhance Big Boi's social media presence (Tumblr, Instagram)
Travelled to music festivals to shadow the Digital Media team
Assisted in fulfilling sponsors' marketing requirements at shows
Photographing the artists during the shows
Networking with prospective sponsors and artists

positions.title: Brand Development Manager / Creative Advisor
positions.description:
Act as a liason between client and TB partners.
Attend meetings with clients, and report to TB partners.
Research content for clients on topics relating to their product
Consult clients based on knowledge of my demographic's wants and needs
Write notes during conference calls
Making Powerpoint presentations of research and presenting them to consultants.
Data entry in Excel

positions.title: Digital Media Intern
positions.description:
Assisted company with SEO using code
Provide assistance in office tasks
Email advertising clients
Web development using Wix and HTML5
Create presentations based on new social media management techniques and platforms
Writing and researching for web content for travel blog
